retroterm-ai.resumen: Retro-futuristic hub with a terminal look: AI assistant, code editor, games, articles and network tools.
descripcion: Retroterm-AI is a site with a CRT terminal look that brings several tools together in one place.

It includes ARIA, an AI assistant running on Cloudflare Workers and the Groq API with a Llama model; CODE_CRT, an in-browser code editor; a DeFi terminal; technical articles; network tools such as IP, binary and hex conversion or CIDR calculation; and a games section with Naval Strike and Wonder IV.
It has three colour themes (green, cyan and amber) that are remembered between visits.
retroterm-ai.problema: Bringing together useful tools for the IT field (networking, code and AI) in a single place, while also working as a personal website.
retroterm-ai.papel: Personal project, started in my first year of ASIR: full design and development.

WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit applied to 16 pages, with its fixes.

wonder-iv.resumen: Match-three puzzle in the browser: each level is a wonder rebuilt piece by piece while its ASCII art appears line by line.
descripcion: A 7 × 7 board with seven tile types. Each wonder is split into three eras that ask for specific tiles and multiply the score.
Special gems when you line up four or five, four limited-use powers (bomb, lightning, shuffle and aurora) and stars based on the moves you have left.
Eight wonders, from the Pyramid to the Oracle, with rising difficulty. It was born inside Retroterm-AI and is now developed on its own, in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
wonder-iv.papel: Personal project: game design, SVG gems, ASCII art and development.
alts: A Wonder IV game on the Pyramid: gem board on the left and the wonder being rebuilt on the right.
Wonder IV menu with the eight wonders and their difficulty.
Wonder IV on a phone.

ninja-de-escritorio.resumen: Slice retro computer icons in a Windows 95 style game, plain HTML5, for desktop and mobile.
descripcion: Slice folders, floppy disks and CD-ROMs, dodge viruses and blue screens and beat malware bosses.
A roguelike Descent mode: nine floors, one for each layer of the PC, with a branching map, 23 upgrades, 6 synergies, relics and a three-phase final boss.
All the art is pixel art drawn by code, in a single index.html with no libraries. It plays with a mouse or a finger and respects the reduced motion setting.
ninja-de-escritorio.papel: Personal project: game design, code-generated pixel art and development.
alts: Ninja de Escritorio menu with Windows 95 style windows and buttons.
A game of Ninja de Escritorio slicing folder and floppy icons.
Branching map of Descent mode, with waves, elites, a market and bosses.
Fight against the final boss, the Master Processor.

kaiten.resumen: Installable web app to count sushi pieces: tap and it adds one.
descripcion: Touch counter with combos, pace and a personal record for nine piece types in three categories.
Stats with a seven-day chart, a meal history with place, duration and cost, reviews with photos and a map of your places built with OpenFreeMap and MapLibre.
Achievements, daily challenges and colour themes. On a computer, from 1000 px, it shows a live panel next to the counter.
It works offline, installs as an app and keeps everything on the device: no accounts, no server and no tracking.
kaiten.problema: Keeping track of what you eat at a conveyor-belt sushi restaurant, and what it costs, without signing up for anything and without a connection.
kaiten.papel: Personal project: design, SVG illustrations and development in a single file.
alts: Kaiten on a computer: piece counter with the current meal panel next to it.
Kaiten counter on a phone, with the central plate to add pieces.
Kaiten stats with the chart for the last seven days.
A meal review in Kaiten with rating, tags and photos.

hilo-cortado.resumen: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with wooden puppets rebelling against the puppeteer: every hit spends a string.
descripcion: Cut the arm strings and the enemy drops its weapon; cut the head string and it collapses. The strings are both your life and your weapon.
The characters have no sprites: they are cut-out puppets whose poses are interpolated by code, hanging from a visible control bar.
Local co-op for two, with keyboard or gamepad, in a single index.html with no dependencies.
hilo-cortado.papel: Personal project: game design, procedural animation and development.
alts: First act of Hilo Cortado: puppets fighting on the theatre stage.
A boss fight in Hilo Cortado.
Hilo Cortado title screen.

dead-heat.resumen: A maze of embers to collect with ice walls that melt: you change the route.
descripcion: You are a flame in an ice maze. The embers you collect charge heat, and heat melts walls, opens shortcuts and releases water that spreads through the corridors.
Water slows some enemies and speeds up others, and if it freezes again it can trap them. A big ember makes enemies vulnerable for a few seconds.
Pixel art drawn by code, synthesised sound and music, in a single index.html with no dependencies.
dead-heat.papel: Personal project: game design, code-drawn graphics, sound and development.
alts: A Dead Heat game: the flame moves through an ice maze collecting embers.
The flame melts an ice wall and opens a shortcut.
Water spread through the corridors after melting the ice.

panal-roto.resumen: Falling-piece puzzle on a hexagonal board, with lines in three directions and chain collapses.
descripcion: A honeycomb of 9 columns by 16 rows and the ten possible shapes made of four hexagons. Lines close in zigzag and along both diagonals.
After each clear, whatever is left collapses, and if the fall completes another line a chain begins. It includes a colour-blind mode.
A single index.html with no dependencies, using HTML5 Canvas and sound synthesised with Web Audio, plus automated tests.
panal-roto.papel: Personal project: game design and development.
alts: A Panal Roto game on the hexagonal board.
Panal Roto menu.
Panal Roto on a phone.

caja-de-arena.resumen: Particle simulator in the browser: sand, water, fire, gunpowder, acid, plants and lava reacting to each other.
descripcion: Each material follows local rules: fire sets wood alight, lava boils water away and acid dissolves sand.
A brush in three sizes, pause, sample scenes and keyboard shortcuts to pick materials.
alts: Caja de Arena with a sample scene of sand, water and other materials.

lorekeeper.resumen: Serverless, portable reading tracker with 3D books, a timer, stats and optional achievements.
descripcion: A reading timer that keeps counting with the app closed, audiobooks included, and 3D books in the colour of their cover.
A library with shelves, series and loans; search in Google Books, Open Library and Apple Books, an ISBN scanner and import from CSV or Excel.
Stats, a yearly summary, 24 achievements and optional levels, and six visual styles. It even works by double-clicking the file, and keeps everything on the device.
lorekeeper.papel: Personal project: design and development in plain JavaScript and CSS.
alts: A collage of LoreKeeper screens with 3D books, stats and the library.
LoreKeeper's six visual styles, three dark and three light.

hemiciclo.resumen: General election night simulator: a real map of the provinces and a 350-seat Congress filling up live.
descripcion: Animated vote count across the 52 constituencies with their real shapes, seat allocation with D'Hondt and a breaking-news column with swings and key seats.
Scenarios with probabilities calculated from 400 Monte Carlo simulations, live coalitions, a coalition builder and a historical mode from 1977 to 2023.
It is built from src/ into a single index.html, with automated tests and screenshots at 1440 and 390 px that check nothing overflows. It is the base of a political strategy game in the works.
hemiciclo.papel: Personal project: design, election engine and interface.
alts: Hemiciclo on election night: map of provinces and Congress filling up seat by seat.
Coalitions panel with the possible deals and the coalition builder.
Historical mode with results from 1977 to 2023.
Hemiciclo on a phone.

inventario-vinilos.resumen: Web app to catalogue a record collection, published on GitHub Pages.
descripcion: Shelves with records in a carousel, a table view exportable to Excel and stats by genre, decade, artist and format.
When you add a record it queries MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive to fill in year, genre and cover; it also accepts a photo taken with your phone.
Sync between devices encrypted on the device itself, through a Cloudflare Worker that cannot read the data, automatic backups and tests in a real browser before every release.
inventario-vinilos.problema: Cataloguing a large record collection without losing a single one: version 2 was rebuilt inside so that a browser glitch can never empty the collection.
inventario-vinilos.papel: Personal project: design, development and sync server.
alts: Inventory shelves with records in a carousel.
A record's page with cover, rating, tracks and notes.
Collection stats by genre, decade and artist.
Record inventory on a phone.

impronta.resumen: Hand-made website for a fictional print shop, built during my work placement, with a WordPress version, a process dossier and a weekly log.
descripcion: Corporate website for a fictional print shop in Madrid, with eleven pages: home with video, services catalogue, history and team, a blog with three articles, contact, legal pages and a custom error page.
It includes a business card generator that draws the card in real time in three styles and downloads the front and back as PNG.

On my own initiative, beyond what the brief required: CSS variables, fluid typography with clamp(), a theme saved in the browser, a step-by-step form more complete than required, a cookie panel with categories and Open Graph metadata.
The project was also delivered as a WordPress version, together with a process dossier and a weekly log.
impronta.papel: End-of-year project of my first year of ASIR, built during my work placement (FCT) for the Markup Languages module: full design and development.
alts: Impronta home page: “We print what you imagine” on a midnight blue background with gold details.
Impronta services page with digital printing and its finishes.
Business card generator with the form and the card preview.
Impronta home page on a phone.

nexus.resumen: Themed social network built from scratch in PHP and MySQL, connecting people through their taste in music and video games.
descripcion: Sign-up with bcrypt-hashed passwords and PHP sessions, a feed of posts with votes and replies, and profiles with avatar, bio and status.
An affinity engine matches your tastes with everyone else's and ranks users by compatibility percentage, showing the tastes you share.
A MySQL database with users, tastes, posts, connections and votes; the profile is saved with fetch without reloading the page.
nexus.papel: Personal project from my first year of ASIR: full design, database and development.
alts: NEXUS home page: community search with filters for music, gaming, metal and other genres.

project-dossier.resumen: Static case archive with a D3 connections map and internal editing tools.
descripcion: A documentary archive of classified and declassified cases, with a D3 force map, a timeline, a sortable archive and five case files with interactive timelines.
Each file is based on public domain or already published documents; the project does not claim that the theories it collects are true.
alts: Project Dossier home page with case counters and case file cards.

D3 connections map between cases, people and organisations.

edulab.resumen: Educational platform with gamified modules to learn technology by playing.
descripcion: An experience and rank system saved in the browser. Modules: SQLQuest (six SQL mini-games), Signal Repair (13 CSS missions with Flexbox and Grid) and SysAdmin (an interactive terminal, Linux permissions and Bash).
alts: EduLab home page with the list of subjects, the experience earned and access to SQLQuest.
SQLQuest: mini-games to learn SQL from SELECT to JOIN.
Signal Repair: CSS missions with Flexbox, Grid and positioning.

as-study.resumen: Single-file study tool for ASIR, installable as an app.
descripcion: Pomodoro timer, global search, stats, flashcards with spaced repetition and an exam mode.
alts: ASIR Study widget panel with the card of the day and quick links.
ASIR Study on a phone.

pokemon-bash-simulator.resumen: Turn-based battle simulator written in Bash, where every creature is a Linux user.
descripcion: Every creature is a real system user created with useradd, types are Linux groups and stats live in files inside their home folder. The loser is removed with userdel -r and a “centre” script restores them all.
It grew over three versions: turn-based combat with critical hits and speed; multiple types and a special attack; and the final version.
pokemon-bash-simulator.papel: Linux system administration project from my first year of ASIR.

retroamp.resumen: Retro music player with custom skins, installable as an app on your phone.
descripcion: An in-browser player with a 90s look and skins that can be exported and imported as JSON.
It loads your own MP3 files, generates a vinyl cover for each song with Canvas and plays them with the Web Audio API.
alts: RetroAmp on a computer: player with equaliser and playlist.
RetroAmp on a phone, with the generated vinyl cover and the controls.
